basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas. I work as a software developer for a gaming company, which neatly aligns with my passion for video games. I enjoy playing Apex Legends, and I’m a big fan of RPGs, particularly those with Isekai themes. I dislike toxic gaming environments and always strive to foster a supportive community. My online hours are usually in the evenings and weekends, as I balance my gaming with work and social commitments. Recently single, I spend my free time gaming, coding personal projects, and exploring new tech.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science, I’ve honed my skills in both software development and game design. I’ve been part of several indie game projects and have a keen interest in emerging gaming technologies. Most of my knowledge comes from both formal education and extensive self-teaching through online courses and community involvement.
